name: Report of Emergency Expenditures Exceeding Appropriations
description: Emergency purchases exceeding budget appropriations are reported with a recommendation of the funds to transfer to cover them.
preparedBy: Superintendent or Director of Business Services
deadline: At the next public Board meeting
quote: Any expenditure in excess of budgetary appropriations made in accordance with this provision shall be reported to the Board at the next public meeting, with a recommendation of funds to be transferred to cover said purchase.
